presets.name: Reference A 432
presets.desc: Chromatic tuner with A4 at 432 Hz instead of 440: every note's target 31.8 ¢ lower
presets.notes: reference is normally one golem-wide setting; this preset sets it for this block only

presets.name: Baroque A 415
presets.desc: Chromatic strobe at A4 = 415 Hz, the usual baroque pitch, heard while tuning
presets.notes: 415 Hz is a semitone under 440 within 1 ¢

presets.name: Drift watch
presets.desc: Put away but still measuring: never mutes, keeps publishing the pitch for golem's drift badge
presets.notes: Long sets and changing temperature: the strings drift while playing, golem shows a small sharp / flat mark

presets.name: Voice practice
presets.desc: Chromatic reading with note hysteresis for a voice or a violin: a bend keeps its note until 60 ¢
presets.notes: The coarse stage reads up to about 1.5 kHz (F6); above, no reading

highcut.name: High Cut
highcut.help: Fizz control; a dark lead sweep

align.name: Align
align.help: Leading-delay trim and auto-polarity; B aligned to A by correlation

delay_b.name: Delay B
delay_b.help: Fine phase: + delays B, − delays A

length.name: Length
length.help: IR trim; ≥ the IR's length = untouched

fade.name: Fade
fade.help: Half-Hann fade over the end of a trimmed IR

normalize.name: Normalize
normalize.help: Level match between IRs, at the level of a typical cab IR played raw

min_phase.name: Min Phase
min_phase.help: Minimum-phase transform (tight, no pre-delay, easy blends)

bass_keep.name: Bass Keep
bass_keep.help: Shared id: below it the dry plays instead of the cab

stereo.name: Stereo
stereo.help: 2 / 2 only: same blend both sides, or A left / B right (as Linked while B is none)

presets.name: Single close mic
presets.desc: One miked cab at zero latency, onset trimmed and level-matched to a typical cab IR
presets.notes: The default: whatever IR golem picks plays at the library's usual level, so swaps do not jump

presets.name: Two-mic blend
presets.desc: A dynamic and a ribbon of one cab blended, aligned by correlation so the pair cannot comb
presets.notes: Set ir_b to the second mic of the same cab; Correlation fixes polarity and the sub-millisecond lag

presets.name: Session-true blend
presets.desc: Two mics captured together kept at their recorded distance, the phase nudged by ear
presets.notes: Raw keeps the captured phase; move delay_b by ±0.1 ms to taste

presets.name: Mic sweep pedal
presets.desc: Expression sweeps from one mic position to another of the same speaker
presets.notes: EXP on blend 0 → 100 %: a two-point mic move; ir_b = the same speaker off-axis

presets.name: Tight metal rhythm
presets.desc: Proximity boom and fizz cut after the cab for palm-muted high gain

presets.name: Wide double cab
presets.desc: Two different cabs, one per side, from one amp
presets.notes: 2 / 2 only; ir_a and ir_b = two different cabs; with ir_b none it plays linked

presets.name: Bass cab over DI
presets.desc: The lows stay on the DI and the cab only colours the mids and highs
presets.notes: A bass cab IR in ir_a; below 120 Hz the dry plays instead of the cab

presets.name: Bass cab plus parallel DI
presets.desc: A bass cab with the clean DI blended under it

presets.name: Acoustic body
presets.desc: A piezo pickup through a body IR, the piezo kept underneath
presets.notes: A body IR in ir_a; normalize Off if the capture is unity-gain

presets.name: Small speaker
presets.desc: A phone or practice-amp speaker: thin, boxy, band-limited

presets.name: Room cab
presets.desc: A far-miked cab with its room, the whole IR kept
presets.notes: No forced truncation: a long room IR plays whole

presets.name: Tight minimum phase
presets.desc: IRs from different vendors blended in minimum phase: tight, no pre-delay, no combing

presets.name: Short IR
presets.desc: A cab trimmed to 40 ms with a fade, for a small board

presets.name: Dark lead
presets.desc: High cut on the expression pedal for a lead that darkens on the toe
presets.notes: EXP on highcut

presets.name: Raw parity
presets.desc: The file played exactly as it is, no trim and no level match
presets.notes: For converted chains and unity-gain pedal captures (README R7)

wet.name: Wet
wet.help: Effect level (catalogue id); with Loudness, the effect's level against the dry

ir_a.name: IR
ir_a.help: Slot of the IR in golem's index

length.name: Length
length.help: Shorten a tail; ≥ the IR's length = untouched

fade.name: Fade
fade.help: Half-Hann fade over the end of a shortened IR

normalize.name: Normalize
normalize.help: Level match: pink noise 60 Hz – 12 kHz at 0 dB; Off = the file as it is

width.name: Width
width.help: Mid / side on the wet; 100 % = untouched

presets.name: Spring tank
presets.desc: A captured spring reverb, whole and in stereo, the boom thinned
presets.notes: Spring IR in ir_a; trails let it ring on bypass

presets.name: Tape echo capture
presets.desc: A tape echo's repeats as captured, darkened a little
presets.notes: The echo is in the IR: no feedback control

presets.name: Reverse swell
presets.desc: A plate or hall played backwards: notes swell into the next

presets.name: Short room for voice
presets.desc: A room IR trimmed to 600 ms with a slow fade and narrowed

presets.name: Wide hall
presets.desc: A hall IR spread past the speakers, lows cut

presets.name: Dub tail
presets.desc: A long echo capture behind a slap of predelay, dark and wide

presets.name: Raw file
presets.desc: The IR exactly as captured, no level match: parity with converted chains
presets.notes: Converted ir-fx chains pin Off so their wet keeps its meaning (README R7)

corr.name: Correction
corr.help: Share of the pitch error removed

filter.name: Filter
filter.help: How tightly a held note is kept (one-pole time constant)

transition.name: Transition
transition.help: How fast a new note is caught

vibrato.name: Vibrato
vibrato.help: The singer's vibrato through the correction: 0 % = treated as error (removed as far as filter allows), 100 % = kept intact even at filter 0, 200 % = doubled

fastmode.name: Fast Correction
fastmode.help: On = Live (4.3 – 9.3 ms); off = Studio (PSOLA, exact formants, 17 – 37 ms, corrected from the first cycle)

offset.name: Offset
offset.help: Constant shift added to the correction; with corr 0, a plain transposition

flex.name: Flex
flex.help: Leaves far-off pitches alone: at 100 %, 15 ¢ off is pulled fully, 60 ¢ + is left as sung (bends, blue notes)

hysteresis.name: Note Hold
hysteresis.help: How far past the midpoint the held note is kept (x42's bias 0.5 = 23 ¢)

formant_keep.name: Formant Keep
formant_keep.help: Studio: keeps the vowel's formants when shifting (PSOLA); off = formants move with the pitch (x42)

register.name: Register
register.help: Voice range (60 – 500 · 90 – 800 · 150 – 1,200 Hz); sets the Live latency

sens.name: Sensitivity
sens.help: Voicing thresholds (gfx-golem): higher corrects rougher, breathier notes, at more risk

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Under this input level, no correction (offset only): stage bleed is never retuned

m00.name: C
m00.help: Note mask: C allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m01.name: C#
m01.help: Note mask: C# allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m02.name: D
m02.help: Note mask: D allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m03.name: D#
m03.help: Note mask: D# allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m04.name: E
m04.help: Note mask: E allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m05.name: F
m05.help: Note mask: F allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m06.name: F#
m06.help: Note mask: F# allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m07.name: G
m07.help: Note mask: G allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m08.name: G#
m08.help: Note mask: G# allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m09.name: A
m09.help: Note mask: A allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m10.name: A#
m10.help: Note mask: A# allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m11.name: B
m11.help: Note mask: B allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

presets.name: Transparent live
presets.desc: Steady pitch pulled 80 % onto the note; vibrato, bends and far-off notes left as sung; Live latency
presets.notes: The design's transparent setting (README §4): golem's default use; the song key is applied by golem when the scale is not Chromatic

presets.name: Live natural
presets.desc: Fast but not instant help on held notes (84 %, 33 ms): x42's own Live preset
presets.notes: x42-Autotune's factory Live preset (corr 0.84, filter 0.033), kept for golem users who knew it

presets.name: Slightly corrected
presets.desc: A third of the pitch error removed, slowly: the singer's own pitch, a little steadier
presets.notes: x42-Autotune's factory Slightly Corrected preset

presets.name: Tight pop
presets.desc: Notes land fast on the key's scale, held notes stay human, vibrato kept
presets.notes: Two times: transition 15 ms for the landing, filter 40 ms on the held note (README §3.5 re-voicing of golem's Tight pop)

presets.name: Stair-step robot
presets.desc: Instant steps between the scale's notes, vibrato flattened: the 2000s hard-tune sound

refs.why: the instant note steps that made hard tuning an effect
the stair-step vocal used as the lead sound on every hook

presets.notes: filter 0 and transition 0 are the robot; the minor scale and a short note hold keep the steps on the melody's notes

presets.name: Hard tune, vibrato kept
presets.desc: Instant note steps while the singer's own vibrato rides on top of each note
presets.notes: The vibrato model splits the vibrato off once 2 – 3 of its cycles are heard; before that the first notes are flat

presets.name: Exaggerated vibrato
presets.desc: Locked notes with the singer's vibrato deepened to nearly twice its depth
presets.notes: Above 100 % the fitted sinusoid is added, so the jitter is not deepened with it

presets.name: Backing vocals lock
presets.desc: Unison and harmony lines pulled hard onto the notes so stacked voices lock together
presets.notes: Half the vibrato removed so stacked singers stop beating against each other

presets.name: Blues bends kept
presets.desc: Held notes helped toward the minor pentatonic; bends and blue notes beyond 60 cents left alone
presets.notes: Flex 100 %: 15 cents off is pulled fully, 60 cents or more is a deliberate bend and stays

presets.name: Sparse scale, steady
presets.desc: Pentatonic targets with a long note hold: an uncertain singer stays on the tune without hopping
presets.notes: Hysteresis 35 cents: the held note wins until the voice is 85 cents from it

presets.name: High voice, in-ears
presets.desc: Transparent correction for a high voice at the lowest latency (High register, 4.3 ms)
presets.notes: register High: 150 – 1,200 Hz, the Live latency falls to 4.3 ms; a setup parameter (changes the reported latency)

presets.name: Studio render
presets.desc: Every note corrected from its first cycle with the formants kept: for a recorded take
presets.notes: fastmode off = Studio (PSOLA, 26 ms in Mid): recalling it changes the reported latency, so keep it for renders, not live scenes

presets.name: Semitone down, formants kept
presets.desc: The whole voice a semitone lower with its vowels unchanged: a song moved down without retuning
presets.notes: Studio only keeps the formants in v1 (Live moves them 6 %); recalling it changes the reported latency

presets.name: Fretless and cello
presets.desc: Gentle intonation help for a fretless bass or a cello: low register, vibrato kept
presets.notes: register Low reaches 60 Hz; its Live latency is 9.3 ms

presets.name: Horns and strings
presets.desc: Light intonation help for trumpet, sax or violin; scoops and falls kept
presets.notes: Flex 60 %: scoops into the note are left, the held note is helped

presets.name: Pitch meter only
presets.desc: No correction: the block reads the sung note and its error for the singer's monitor
presets.notes: Read the note and error meters; the output is the input delayed by the Live latency

source.name: Carrier
source.help: What the voice is imposed on

chord.name: Chord
chord.help: Tracked and Drone: notes stacked diatonically in key / scale

formant.name: Formant
formant.help: Moves the voice's formants without moving the pitch: + smaller and brighter, − bigger and darker

env_rel.name: Release
env_rel.help: How long a band rings after the voice leaves it

sib.name: Sibilance
sib.help: The voice's own highs above the bank, full on "s / t / f", −12 dB during vowels, gated with the voice

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Equal-power crossfade, dry (the main input) to vocoded

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.help: Holds the current vowel; the carrier keeps playing

spacing.name: Spacing
spacing.help: ERB puts resolution where speech is understood (1 – 4 kHz); Log is the analog layout

high.name: High
high.help: Centre of the highest band; the sibilance pass starts here

width.name: Width
width.help: Band width relative to the flattest one for this band count

thresh.name: Gate
thresh.help: Below it the modulator is treated as silence (mic bleed), sibilance path included

flatten.name: Flatten
flatten.help: Removes the carrier's own spectral tilt so the voice's spectrum comes through

unvoiced.name: Unvoiced
unvoiced.help: Carrier replaced by noise during unvoiced sounds (the EMS switch), and at a phrase start until the pitch is known

noise.name: Noise
noise.help: Noise always added to the carrier: breath, and highs for a dark carrier

register.name: Register
register.help: Tracked: the range the pitch is searched in

quantize.name: Quantize
quantize.help: Tracked root: as sung · nearest semitone (robot steps) · nearest note of the key

glide.name: Glide
glide.help: Tracked root portamento (gfx-octaver's id and range)

degree.name: Degree
degree.help: Drone: the scale degree the chord stands on (five-note scales: 6 and 7 = 1 and 2 an octave up)

key.name: Key
key.help: Song key (gfx-pitch's id); golem sets it per song

spread.name: Spread
spread.help: 2 / 2 only: even bands left, odd bands right

presets.name: Robot talk
presets.desc: The voice's own melody stepped to the nearest semitone on a saw, words kept clear by flatten and sibilance
presets.notes: No keyboard: the carrier follows the singer. Chromatic quantize gives the robot steps; 24 bands keep vowel onsets within 8 ms

presets.name: Choir of one
presets.desc: A three-part supersaw harmony that follows the singer in the song's key, vowels from the voice
presets.notes: golem sets key / scale per song. The added notes are diatonic thirds and fifths above the sung note

presets.name: Monotone machine
presets.desc: A fixed-pitch buzz an octave down speaks every word: harsh, flat and fully intelligible
presets.notes: Buzz is the flattest carrier; 32 bands for spoken precision (slower vowel onsets: keep it for slow lines)

presets.name: Song-key pad
presets.desc: A vocoded seventh chord in the song key sings under the dry voice; scenes move the degree
presets.notes: Mix 35 % keeps the dry voice in front; golem changes `degree` per scene (verse vi, chorus IV)

presets.name: Hold the ahh
presets.desc: Sing a vowel, stomp freeze: the vowel stays on a supersaw triad while you sing over it
presets.notes: Freeze on a foot switch; the held vowel ignores the gate, the sibilance stays live

presets.name: Whisper
presets.desc: A breathy, pitchless voice: the words imposed on noise, sibilance well up
presets.notes: Good for spoken intros; the noise carrier needs no unvoiced switch

presets.name: Small voice
presets.desc: The voice's formants raised four semitones at the same pitch: a smaller, brighter singer
presets.notes: Few, wide analysis bands follow the formants, not the harmonics. A coarse colour; gfx-formant is the clean shifter

presets.name: Big voice
presets.desc: The voice's formants lowered four semitones at the same pitch: a bigger, darker singer
presets.notes: Sib 0: with Self the pass-through and the top band are the same signal and would comb

presets.name: Synth guitar
presets.desc: Single notes played on a supersaw fifth that follows the guitar, shaped by the pick's attack and decay
presets.notes: Instrument register (75 Hz – 1.5 kHz, harmonic lock); single notes, not chords

presets.name: Strings vocoder
presets.desc: Eleven wide log bands on an ensemble'd triad: the few-band, smeared choir of late-70s keyboard vocoders
presets.notes: Flatten 0 is the vintage carrier × voice response; the 4 dB gaps between bands are part of the sound

presets.name: Robot octaves
presets.desc: The sung note and the octave below on a pulse wave, stepped to semitones: a thick robot lead
presets.notes: The added octave sits under the melody, so the tune stays on top

presets.name: Talking chords
presets.desc: The keys' rhythm and timbre carve a song-key triad drone: the chord speaks with the playing
presets.notes: The keys are the modulator; scenes move `degree` with the progression

model.name: Model
model.help: The body; owns its modes, high band, decay and K

body.name: Body
body.help: The body's resonances (the boom, the breath): 50 % = the model's own, ±12 dB

top.name: Top
top.help: Attack and sparkle, and the trim for a guitar that is not the pickup guess: 50 % = the model's own

mic.name: Mic
mic.help: Microphone blend: 0 bridge, 50 sound hole, 100 neck (12th – 14th fret)

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Law: linear crossfade, 0 = the DI, 100 = the acoustic

twelve.name: 12-String
twelve.help: Adds the octave and unison courses

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.help: The guitar's pickup, so its EMF can be rebuilt from the DI (golem sets it at insert)

size.name: Size
size.help: Body scale: every mode at f · 100 / size

decay.name: Decay
decay.help: Shortens the electric's sustain as an acoustic body drains the strings: 50 % = the model's own, 0 = off

piezo.name: Piezo Blend
piezo.help: Adds an under-saddle piezo voice to the mic: the stage sound

quack.name: Quack Cut
quack.help: Piezo source only: tames the piezo's mid peak on the attacks

low_cut.name: Low Cut
low_cut.help: 2-pole high-pass after the body: band mix, feedback

room.name: Room
room.help: The small room around the mic

width.name: Width
width.help: 2 / 2 only: the spacing of the two microphones

twelve_level.name: Courses Level
twelve_level.help: Octave and unison strings relative to the main courses

twelve_delay.name: Strum Offset
twelve_delay.help: Delay of the course voices on top of the shifter's 3 ms centre and the octave bands' own 5 – 9 ms

level.name: Level
level.help: 0 dB = the bypass loudness on every model

presets.name: Studio dreadnought
presets.desc: Electric DI to a miked dreadnought between sound hole and neck, a light comp and room
presets.notes: The reference: neck single coil, modal lows, the decay stage at the model's own shortening

presets.name: Big jumbo strum
presets.desc: A jumbo body with more boom under strummed chords, compressed for a band mix
presets.notes: Body 60 % lifts the modal bank 2.4 dB: the deeper air and top modes of the larger box

presets.name: Fingerstyle concert
presets.desc: The measured grand-concert body, a brighter attack and shorter sustain between picks
presets.notes: Concert is fitted from public-domain recordings of a steel-string; decay 60 % shortens tails between picks

presets.name: Single-note lead
presets.desc: Long electric notes decay like an acoustic's: the sustain that gives a sim away is gone
presets.notes: Where the decay stage acts fully: single lines and long notes

presets.name: Parlor blues
presets.desc: A small-body parlor: boxy midrange, a little more top, a small room
presets.notes: Parlor's modes sit about 20 % higher than the dreadnought's (body area); body 40 % keeps the boom down

presets.name: Nylon bossa
presets.desc: The archive-fitted classical body, dark top and a short nylon decay, miked near the neck
presets.notes: Classical is fitted from a measured Spanish concert guitar (CC BY 4.0 archive); its k is higher in the highs

presets.name: Twelve-string jangle
presets.desc: Octave and unison courses added before the body, detuned and strummed late, compressed
presets.notes: Octave voice below 400 Hz from the ERB bank, unison above 150 Hz; 4 cents and 2.5 ms on the shifter's 3 ms

presets.name: Stage acoustic
presets.desc: Piezo and mic blended with the lows cut: cuts through a loud band and resists feedback
presets.notes: The piezo voice is F̂ through the force conversion plus a 2 kHz bell; low cut 100 Hz keeps the body boom out

presets.name: Round-back stage
presets.desc: A subdued round-back body with a strong piezo voice: the bright stage acoustic
presets.notes: Few low-Q modes and a short tail, as the round-back's subdued body resonance

presets.name: Piezo restore
presets.desc: An acoustic-electric's piezo DI given back its body and mic, quack tamed, blended with the DI
presets.notes: Concert with a piezo source is the measured guitar's own piezo-to-mic response; pick the nearest body

presets.name: Electric to acoustic
presets.desc: Mix on the expression pedal: morph the electric DI into the miked acoustic mid-song
presets.notes: Put EXP on mix 0 → 100 %: the wet has no bulk delay, so the sweep has no comb

presets.name: Wide doubled acoustic
presets.desc: Two microphones from one body on a stereo lane, a little room
presets.notes: 2 / 2 only: the mics sit at mic ± width / 2 on the same modal bank; the lows stay coherent

presets.name: Bridge-pickup rescue
presets.desc: A bridge humbucker turned into a usable acoustic: position shelf and aperture shelf
presets.notes: The position shelf adds up to 13.8 dB of lows re the treble; top 45 % trims what the guess leaves

presets.name: Small-body morph
presets.desc: The body shrinks under the expression pedal: every mode glides up, no click
presets.notes: Put EXP on size 140 → 80 %: modes at f · 100 / size, coefficients ramped every 32 samples

presets.name: Ringing sustain
presets.desc: The measured concert body with the electric's full sustain kept, a larger room
presets.notes: Decay 0 is bit-exact pass-through of the strings' sustain: long notes ring as on the electric

drive.name: Drive
drive.help: Shared id: extra saturation on top of the model's own

noise.name: Noise
noise.help: Channel noise and reception, relative: 50 % = the model's own

distance.name: Distance
distance.help: Listener distance: direct / room ratio, HF loss, handset leak

squelch.name: Squelch
squelch.help: Keying threshold: 0 = always open; else −80 + 0.6 · n dBFS (25 % = −65 dBFS)

band.name: Bandwidth
band.help: Both edges ±1 octave around the model's band; the 8 kHz converters still cut at 4 kHz

codec.name: Codec
codec.help: Cell codec coarseness, relative: 50 % = the model's own (law below); 0 % = the predictor and the noise suppressor are exact identities

dropouts.name: Dropouts
dropouts.help: Packet loss (Cell: 0.3 % of frames per %, in bursts), multipath fading (AM), Rayleigh fading (NBFM), crackle (Phone Line, Gramophone)

whistle.name: Whistle
whistle.help: AM spur level re the carrier; its pitch follows tune

squelch_tail.name: Tail
squelch_tail.help: Hang and squelch-tail time; 100 % = the model's (NBFM 150 ms)

battery.name: Battery
battery.help: Rail voltage of battery amps: lower = earlier clip, more crossover, sag, sputter below 30 %

rattle.name: Rattle
rattle.help: Voice-coil rub at X_max: the blown speaker

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Dry ↔ wet linear crossfade

presets.name: Old phone call
presets.desc: Carbon-mic handset over an analog line: 2nd-harmonic grit, line hum and hiss that stop in silence
presets.notes: The default: recognisable at once with no drive; the noise follows the voice (squelch 25 %)

presets.name: Readable phone vocal
presets.desc: Telephone opened half an octave each way, less line noise: still a phone, readable in a dense mix
presets.notes: band opens the device around its own voicing instead of blending the dry back in

presets.name: Phone layer
presets.desc: A thin telephone copy blended under the clean vocal for presence
presets.notes: Keep mix at 30 % or less: between 35 and 70 % the device and the dry comb like two out-of-phase sources

presets.name: Bad signal
presets.desc: Cell call breaking up: smeared formants, hoarse excitation, bursty lost packets and comfort noise

presets.name: Video call
presets.desc: A cell codec heard through a laptop's micro-speaker on a desk

presets.name: Riot bullhorn
presets.desc: Megaphone pushed into its class-B clip, horn throat grit, a street slap behind it

presets.name: Bullhorn lead
presets.desc: The megaphone horn on guitar: less clip, a wider band, no street

presets.name: Walkie check
presets.desc: Push-to-talk radio: voice-keyed carrier, roger beep and the squelch crash when the voice stops

presets.name: Out of range
presets.desc: Walkie at the edge of its range: FM threshold clicks in bursts at the bottom of each fade

presets.name: Tune the dial
presets.desc: AM receiver for the expression pedal: neighbour stations, a squeal through zero beat, static between
presets.notes: Put the expression pedal on tune and sweep −100 → +100 %; the whistle's pitch follows the dial

presets.name: Night fading AM
presets.desc: Distant AM station at night: selective fading sweeps a notch through it, then the carrier distorts

presets.name: Station announcement
presets.desc: Tube PA into horn speakers down a hall, the other horns of the system echoing behind

presets.name: Ticket window
presets.desc: Intercom box behind glass: a ringing metal box, hum, a narrow band

presets.name: Front door buzzer
presets.desc: Cheap intercom pushed into its IC amp's clip, hum up

presets.name: Beach radio
presets.desc: An AM station on a 9 V pocket set: crossover grit and small-speaker breakup

presets.name: Pocket radio intro
presets.desc: The whole band from a transistor radio for an intro, then switch it off
presets.notes: The physical version of the classic radio EQ: 250 Hz – 6 kHz with a 57 mm speaker's breakup

presets.name: Dying battery
presets.desc: A 9 V radio on a flat battery: the rail sags and sputters on every peak

presets.name: Blown speaker
presets.desc: The voice coil rubs at full excursion: buzz and rattle riding the bass notes

presets.name: 78 horn
presets.desc: Acoustic gramophone horn and mica soundbox; chain a 78 medium before it for the record
presets.notes: noise 0 here: the record's surface noise and wow come from the medium pedal chained before

presets.name: Laptop demo
presets.desc: A drum loop played from a laptop on the desk: no bass, a 1 kHz bump, smart-amp pumping

presets.name: Phone on the table
presets.desc: The handset put down on the table: its bass leaks away and the room takes over

presets.name: Line out for a device IR
presets.desc: The device chain without its speaker, for a measured speaker IR in the cab block after it
presets.notes: speaker None is a line out: put golem's cab with a device impulse response after it

presets.name: Broadcast guitar
presets.desc: Guitar heard on a table radio from a station across town

presets.name: Radio keys
presets.desc: Keys from a tube table radio in the next room

amount.name: Stretch amount
amount.help: How much slower the sound plays: ×1 = real time (a smear in Rolling), ×4 = a pad, ×50 + = a drone

fft.name: FFT size
fft.help: Window length: short = tight, grainy, rhythmic; long = smooth, every attack melted

spread.name: Frequency spread
spread.help: Blurs each partial over ± this many cents: 20 – 60 ¢ chorus-like, 100 – 300 ¢ a wash, 1,200 ¢ + noise bands

vol.name: Main volume
vol.help: Level of the stretched sound (the dry is untouched)

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: Capture = takes on the footswitch (the catalogue's gesture); Rolling = hands-free, the head follows the playing

capture.name: Capture
capture.help: Capture mode: on records (up to maxlen), off commits and plays the take looped and stretched

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.help: Holds the current instant forever (both modes)

thru.name: Pass input through
thru.help: The dry at unity, never delayed

pitch.name: Pitch shift
pitch.help: Moves the stretched spectrum by semitones: octave drones, sub layers

fshift.name: Frequency shift
fshift.help: Moves every partial by the same Hz: inharmonic, bell-like (applied before pitch, as PaulXStretch)

compress.name: Compress
compress.help: Evens the frame level: 50 % halves the level swings, 100 % keeps the drone at a constant level through gaps

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.help: 100 % = random phases (the Paulstretch wash); 0 % = coherent slow-motion (clean at ×1.5 – ×4, metallic at ×100)

width.name: Width
width.help: How independent the two channels' phases are: 0 = mono-identical, 100 = a wide wash from a mono DI

xfade.name: Crossfade
xfade.help: Length of the crossfades on commit, resync, unfreeze-resync and the trails fade

hpf.name: Low Cut
hpf.help: High-pass on the wet: keeps a drone from muddying the lane

lpf.name: Tone
lpf.help: Low-pass on the wet: darker, further away

spread_on.name: Enable spread
spread_on.help: The catalogue's module switch: off forces spread to 0

comp_on.name: Enable compressor
comp_on.help: The catalogue's module switch: off forces compress to 0

trails.name: Trails
trails.help: On bypass the wet keeps playing and fades over xfade

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: The VST3 bypass (nih-plug make_bypass), the id every coded effect ships

presets.name: Chord into pad
presets.desc: Stomp on, strum one chord, stomp off: the chord plays eight times slower as a seamless looped pad
presets.notes: The intro pad: the pre-roll seam makes the loop invisible; the 100 Hz cut keeps the pad off the bass

presets.name: Drone under a verse
presets.desc: One low note captured and stretched sixty times into a level, widened drone under the verse
presets.notes: Compress 60 % holds the drone level through the note's decay; spread 120 cents widens each partial

presets.name: Infinite hold
presets.desc: Capture a chord, then Freeze holds one instant of it forever while you play over it
presets.notes: The hold-machine gesture: Freeze on the footswitch; a 4 s crossfade lets the next take arrive slowly

presets.name: Voice into the outro
presets.desc: The last sung line captured and stretched twenty times: the vowels hang over the outro
presets.notes: A 341 ms window keeps the vowels readable; the tone at 9 kHz tames the stretched sibilants

presets.name: Ambient shadow
presets.desc: Hands-free: a slow ghost of what you just played, six times slower, refreshed every twelve seconds
presets.notes: Rolling needs no footswitch: each resync takes a new snapshot of the playing and crossfades to it

presets.name: Live spectral smear
presets.desc: The present, smeared through random phases: a diffuse halo a fifth of a second behind the playing
presets.notes: At ×1 Rolling reads the present: the wet is the input with fresh phases, late by window + hop (213 ms)

presets.name: Slow-motion keys
presets.desc: An arpeggio captured and played two and a half times slower with its notes still clear
presets.notes: Cloud 15 % is the coherent end: peak-locked phases keep the notes, a little randomness hides the phasiness

presets.name: Glass octave drone
presets.desc: A captured chord stretched forty times and lifted an octave into a thin, glassy drone
presets.notes: The pitch remap keeps the power; 40 cents of spread softens the octave's partials

presets.name: Sub bed
presets.desc: A bass note captured, stretched thirty times and dropped an octave: a mono sub bed under the band
presets.notes: Width 0 keeps the low end mono; the tone at 1.5 kHz leaves only the sub

presets.name: Bells from a chord
presets.desc: A captured chord shifted up 70 Hz: inharmonic, bell-like partials stretched twelve times
presets.notes: A frequency shift moves every partial by the same Hz: the harmonic series becomes bells

presets.name: Noise-band wash
presets.desc: Stretched a hundred times and spread over an octave: the playing becomes bands of level, steady noise
presets.notes: The constant-Q blur keeps the energy while it widens; compress 80 % flattens the level swings

presets.name: Tight grain
presets.desc: A riff captured and stretched three times through a 21 ms window: a rhythmic, grainy flutter
presets.notes: Short windows keep the riff's rhythm and add a flutter: the low end of PaulXStretch's grain

presets.name: Scene swell
presets.desc: A take captured beforehand fades back in over six seconds when the pedal is engaged at the chorus
presets.notes: The take survives bypass: engage the block with its scene and the pad swells back from the take's start

presets.name: Glacier
presets.desc: Five hundred times slower, spread and compressed: a note becomes a still, minutes-long glacier
presets.notes: Above ×100: golem's catalogue knob stops at 100, so this preset needs its maximum raised (README §3.1)

presets.name: Ghost voice
presets.desc: Hands-free on a vocal lane: a dark, quiet ghost of the last phrase, three times slower
presets.notes: Rolling on a voice: the ghost follows the song in snapshots; the 5 kHz tone keeps it behind the singer

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.help: Hold: grains come from the last length, which stops changing; release fades in decay

grains.name: Grains
grains.help: Density: overlap (Cloud), grains per step (Rhythm), onsets cycled (Strum), slices (Phrase)

pos.name: Grain Position
pos.help: Where grains start: fraction of length back (Strum: how far back onsets are taken)

size.name: Size
size.help: Grain length (Phrase: inert, the slices set it)

pitch.name: Pitch
pitch.help: Base transposition of every grain (continuous; display snaps to semitones within ±5 cents)

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Wet level, dry at unity (delay / reverb law)

length.name: Length
length.help: The buffer span pos, spray and the hold refer to; Phrase: the loop

length_sync.name: Length Sync
length_sync.help: *L* as a note value (overrides length; capped at 10 s)

spray.name: Spray
spray.help: Position scatter ± % of *L* (and ±25 % size jitter at 100 %)

scan.name: Scan
scan.help: Position travel in % of real time; 0 = holds; +100 % in the hold = time-stretch at speed 1

regular.name: Regularity
regular.help: Cloud onsets: 0 = random (Poisson), 100 = metronomic (synchronous: a buzz at grains/size Hz, on purpose)

chance.name: Chance
chance.help: Probability that a scheduled grain plays

reverse.name: Reverse
reverse.help: Probability that a grain plays backwards

scale.name: Scale
scale.help: Interval set the random interval is drawn from

detune.name: Detune
detune.help: Random ± cents per grain, after the scale (chorus, decorrelation of a hold)

glide.name: Glide
glide.help: Pitch travel over each grain's life

spread.name: Spread
spread.help: Random pan of each grain's mid

seed.name: Seed
seed.help: Picks another reproducible cloud (restarts the variate stream)

live.name: Live Level
live.help: Level of the live layer; 0 % = silent until freeze (the hold-pedal gesture)

kill_dry.name: Kill Dry
kill_dry.help: Removes the dry (parallel lane); shared with gfx-delay, gfx-reverb, gfx-shimmer

trails.name: Trails
trails.help: With bypass: on, the cloud finishes its grains and a hold releases in its decay; off, the wet fades out in 20 ms

presets.name: Standard
presets.desc: A gentle band-limited cloud of the last second under the dry playing, half wet
presets.notes: ZamGrains' Standard played the dry signal; re-authored by intent: grains from ~500 ms back, level matched to the source

presets.name: Hold chord
presets.desc: Silent until held: stomp freeze after a chord and it rings on as a grain field you solo over
presets.notes: Freeze on the footswitch. skip 70 % keeps the pick out: the hold is what rings after the last strum; press it a beat after the chord

presets.name: Hold over a cloud
presets.desc: The hold chord gesture with the live cloud running behind the playing until the stomp
presets.notes: The live cloud stops feeding while held and resumes on release

presets.name: Granular delay
presets.desc: Metronomic grains 400 ms back with feedback: smeared, darkened echoes of the line
presets.notes: Spray 0 and ratio 1: the coherent normalisation makes a clean delay; each pass through the cuts darkens it

presets.name: Shimmer cloud
presets.desc: An octave halo: grains an octave up or down climbing through the feedback, no fizz
presets.notes: Re-authored from ZamGrains' Shimmer cloud (which played the dry). Band-limited +12 grains in the loop stay clean as they climb

presets.name: Fifths halo
presets.desc: Grains in fifths and octaves around the note, fed back into a widening halo
presets.notes: Fifths are safe on any note of a key

presets.name: Chord cloud
presets.desc: One note becomes a major triad: grains on its root, third and fifth, spread wide
presets.notes: Relative to the played note: a colour, not a harmoniser (the third moves with every note)

presets.name: Reverse swells
presets.desc: Every grain backwards with a swelling envelope: half-second reverse blooms
presets.notes: The envelope is independent of the direction: skew +100 makes the classic reverse swell

presets.name: Stutter
presets.desc: Beat-repeat glitches: sixteenth slices of the last bar, flat grains on the grid, some skipped
presets.notes: Re-authored from ZamGrains' Stutter. Positions land on whole steps back; flat grains keep C1 edges

presets.name: Tape-stop repeats
presets.desc: Eighth-note repeats that sag an octave over each grain, like a tape stopping

presets.name: Strum chains
presets.desc: Your last four notes replayed in sixteenths, attack kept: a rhythmic chain of what you played
presets.notes: Grains start 5 ms before each note onset so they keep the pick

presets.name: Arp shards
presets.desc: Recent notes cycled in sixteenths, each shifted by a minor-pentatonic step and panned

presets.name: Repeat the last note
presets.desc: The last note you played repeats in eighths, fading through light feedback

presets.name: Phrase loop
presets.desc: The last bar loops behind you as a looping delay; freeze holds the bar
presets.notes: Contiguous slices crossfade amplitude-complementary: exact unity; the seams are looper crossfades

presets.name: Octave mosaic
presets.desc: Half a bar sliced in eight, each slice an octave up, down or home, a few left out

presets.name: Phrase shuffle
presets.desc: The last bar in sixteen slices, half of them shuffled and a quarter reversed
presets.notes: Shuffled and reversed slices meet with equal-power seams

presets.name: Glide loops
presets.desc: A 1.5 s loop in six slices, each gliding up an octave over its length

presets.name: Particle buzz
presets.desc: Tiny metronomic grains a fifth up: the grain rate itself sounds as a synth-like formant
presets.notes: A synchronous stream is a pitch (3 kHz grain rate here), on purpose

presets.name: Dust
presets.desc: Sparse percussive specks from anywhere in the last second, scattered across the field

presets.name: Time-stretch freeze
presets.desc: Freeze four seconds and scan through them at quarter speed: the phrase, stretched
presets.notes: Stomp Freeze (the footswitch gesture) to hold the last four seconds, then scan through them; Freeze is a gesture, never stored on

presets.name: Granular doubler
presets.desc: A close doubled part: grains 20 ms back, detuned and spread a little, for voice or keys

presets.name: Bass pad
presets.desc: A cloud over the bass with its lows kept dry and clean; freeze holds a note as a pad
presets.notes: The low end stays in the unity dry; freeze as a gesture

delay.name: Onset Delay
delay.help: Time the note is held before the feedback starts to grow

rise.name: Rise
rise.help: From the start of growth to full level: the virtual amp's gain (short = loud amp, close)

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.help: Where the feedback (and each held partial in Sustain) settles, relative to the note's body level

dry.name: Dry
dry.help: Dry level; −60 = off (only the feedback: bowed / EBow swells)

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: Feedback: one harmonic blooms out of the note · Sustain: every partial held at its level · Both: the note held, its harmonic blooming on it

feed.name: Feed
feed.help: The footswitch gesture in Switch mode

distance.name: Distance
distance.help: Natural types: the virtual path to the amp; which harmonic sings

drift.name: Drift
drift.help: Natural types: slow seeded wander of the distance during long holds

chord.name: Chord
chord.help: Which note of a chord feeds back; All = each note (≤ 4) on its own

carry.name: Legato Carry
carry.help: A hammer-on / slide keeps the feedback and moves it to the new note; off: it restarts

release.name: Release
release.help: Fade when the note ends (mute, touch, new pick, feed off)

mute_sens.name: Mute Sensitivity
mute_sens.help: How small a sudden drop ends the note (30 → 10 dB in 60 ms)

max_time.name: Max Hold
max_time.help: Longest bloom or hold, from the start of Rise; 60 = no limit

duck.name: Duck
duck.help: The dry (and the held partials in Both) gives way as the feedback blooms: the note turns into its harmonic

color.name: Color
color.help: Harmonics of the feedback tone; 50 % = the model's pickup voicing, 0 = pure sine

tone.name: Tone
tone.help: Sustain: tilt of the held partials, ±6 dB per octave of partial number; 0 = the note's own body spectrum, − = mellower (a magnetic sustainer's sound)

lowest.name: Lowest Note
lowest.help: Detector floor: 70 Hz guitar, 35 Hz bass

thresh.name: Noise Floor
thresh.help: Nothing below it starts a note; a partial 6 dB below it is no longer followed (its pitch is held)

source.name: Detector Source
source.help: Key = the auxiliary input (the clean DI when placed after the amp)

trails.name: Trails
trails.help: On: bypass releases the bloom over release

presets.name: Octave squeal
presets.desc: A held note blooms into its octave after 0.4 s, phase-locked to the string and following its bends
presets.notes: Before a high-gain amp: the amp gives the octave its grit. Bloom 0 dB lets the octave reach the note's own body level

presets.name: Singing fundamental
presets.desc: The note itself stops dying: its fundamental is topped up from 0.2 s on, so the note just keeps singing
presets.notes: The generated partial only supplies what the string has lost (g = a − d): no doubling, no step when it starts

presets.name: Twelfth scream
presets.desc: The octave and a fifth above the note screams in fast and loud once the note is held
presets.notes: The 3rd harmonic: what a loud amp tends to scream at on the wound strings

presets.name: Two-octave whistle
presets.desc: A slow whistle two octaves above the held note, under the note's own level
presets.notes: The 4th harmonic fits any chord; a slow rise keeps it a whistle rather than a squeal

presets.name: Major-third whistle
presets.desc: A whistle on the 5th harmonic (two octaves and a major third) over major chords
presets.notes: The 5th harmonic is a major third: it clashes over minor chords. Use Two Octaves there

presets.name: Close to the amp
presets.desc: Natural feedback a step from the amp: the loop picks the low harmonics, jumping on bends
presets.notes: The virtual loop's phase sets which of harmonics 1 – 4 wins; a short rise is a loud, close amp

presets.name: Across the room
presets.desc: Natural feedback from across the room: slower, and the winning harmonic changes from note to note
presets.notes: At 3 m the loop's phase turns fast with pitch: neighbouring notes feed back on different harmonics

presets.name: Walk to the amp
presets.desc: Natural feedback up to the 6th harmonic whose winner moves with distance: put Distance on the expression pedal
presets.notes: EXP on distance 0.5 – 3 m: the harmonic changes every few tens of centimetres, each change a cross-fade

presets.name: String climb
presets.desc: The note sings on its fundamental, then rises to the octave, as a magnetic sustainer's harmonic mode does
presets.notes: Duck 60 % lets the dry give way as the octave takes over, so the note turns into its harmonic

presets.name: Bowed lead
presets.desc: Dry off: each note swells from silence on its fundamental, carried across hammer-ons and slides
presets.notes: With the dry at −60 dB only the phase-locked partial is heard; Legato Carry keeps the bow across notes

presets.name: Infinite note
presets.desc: Every partial of the note is held at 6 dB under its body, on its own frequency, for up to a minute
presets.notes: A partial bank, not a loop: no pumping, no hiss raised, the partials drift as on the string. Follow with a reverb

presets.name: Chord drone
presets.desc: Each note of a strummed chord is held on its own partial bank, a little darker than played
presets.notes: Chord All gives each named note (up to four) its own voice; a partial shared by two notes is held once

presets.name: Sustainer mix
presets.desc: The note held at its level with its octave blooming on it, the dry giving way a little
presets.notes: Both: the bank holds the note while the Feedback octave grows; a partial in both takes the larger level

presets.name: Held bass root
presets.desc: A bass note held on its own partials, down to 35 Hz, so a root rings under the band
presets.notes: Lowest 35 Hz switches in the long detector window (55 ms to the first reading on E1)

presets.name: Sub swell
presets.desc: An octave below the note swells in slowly under a lowered dry
presets.notes: The sub runs on its own accumulator at half the tracked fundamental's rate: no partial of the string to grow from

presets.name: Scream on the switch
presets.desc: Nothing until the footswitch: then the held note screams at the twelfth within 0.3 s
presets.notes: golem's footswitch drives Feed; releasing it fades the scream with its pitch held, no chirp

presets.name: Feedback at low volume
presets.desc: Amp-like natural feedback at bedroom or in-ear level, ahead of an amp model
presets.notes: Natural Low stops at the 4th harmonic, as the classic feedback pedals do

engine.name: Engine
engine.help: Spectral: every partial of the guitar turned into a waveform, polyphonic, instant, no tracking · Mono: one synth voice on the note, glide and exact bends, the attack bridged by Spectral

wave.name: Wave
wave.help: Saw · Pulse (50 % = square) · Triangle · Sine: the oscillators (Mono) and the waveform of every band (Spectral)

cutoff.name: Cutoff
cutoff.help: Filter base frequency (golem's UI: a log knob; heel-to-toe EXP sweep)

reso.name: Resonance
reso.help: Filter peak: Q 0.5 … 20 (+26 dB at 100 %); no self-oscillation

filt_env.name: Env Amount
filt_env.help: How far the filter envelope moves the cutoff, up or down

dry.name: Dry
dry.help: Guitar level, untouched; −60 = off (gfx-sustainer's id and range)

octave.name: Octave
octave.help: Transposes the synth (Spectral: z² / √z per band, gfx-octaver Poly's quality)

sub.name: Sub
sub.help: Octave-below square (voices) or sine (core, bands < 400 Hz)

detune.name: Detune
detune.help: Second oscillator (voices) or second copy (core) this many cents sharp: unison width

noise.name: Noise
noise.help: Breath shaped by the note (voices) or by each band (core)

amp_mode.name: Amp Mode
amp_mode.help: Follow: the string's own level, flattened by Hold · Gate: an ADSR from every pick

attack.name: Attack
attack.help: Amp attack (Gate); minimum rise in Follow (swells)

sustain.name: Sustain
sustain.help: Gate only: level held after the decay

compress.name: Hold
compress.help: How much of the string's decay is flattened, per band or per voice; 100 % = held until the floor (organ sustain)

drive.name: Drive
drive.help: Saturation into the filter (contract id; 0 – 24 dB into the tanh); thickens resonance

key_track.name: Key Track
key_track.help: Cutoff follows the note (voices; Spectral has no note)

fenv_dec.name: Env Decay
fenv_dec.help: Filter envelope fall to the base cutoff

fenv_vel.name: Env Velocity
fenv_vel.help: How much the pick strength scales filt_env

bank.name: Resolution
bank.help: Dual: fast bank on attacks, legato and bends, clean bank on held notes · Fast: tightest, chords gritty · Clean: cleanest chords, slow attack (pads)

residue.name: Residue
residue.help: Mono (and Poly): level of the core where the voice does not own the band (the attack, a chord's other notes)

quantize.name: Pitch
quantize.help: Off: bends and vibrato pass · Chromatic: the nearest semitone, held with hysteresis (Mono)

lowest.name: Lowest Note
lowest.help: Detector and bank floor: 70 Hz guitar, 35 Hz bass

thresh.name: Noise Floor
thresh.help: Below it no voice starts and no band sounds (6 dB of hysteresis): touch noise and hum stay silent

spread.name: Spread
spread.help: 2 / 2 only: the unison pair panned apart

trails.name: Trails
trails.help: On: bypass releases the synth over release

presets.name: Synth chord stabs
presets.desc: Every string of a chord becomes a square wave through a plucky low-pass sweep; short, polyphonic, instant
presets.notes: Gate with sustain 0 makes each strum a stab; fast strumming stays on the fast bank (tight, a little gritty)

presets.name: Square pad
presets.desc: Held chords turned into soft square waves that swell in slowly and hold their level: a pad behind the band
presets.notes: Clean bank: the cleanest chords, its slow attack hidden by the 600 ms swell

presets.name: Wide saw pad
presets.desc: Chords as detuned saw waves spread left and right, swelling in and held: the classic string-machine pad
presets.notes: Detune 12 cents makes the unison pair; spread places it left and right on a stereo lane

presets.name: Synth brass
presets.desc: Saw waves with a slow filter swell on every pick: a paraphonic synth-brass section from chords
presets.notes: One filter envelope per pick (paraphonic): the 40 ms filter attack is the brass 'blat'

presets.name: Organ chords
presets.desc: Square waves with a sub-octave on the low strings, every partial held at its body level: organ-like chords
presets.notes: Hold 100 % keeps every partial at its body until the noise floor stops it: no decay, no hiss

presets.name: Synth bass from guitar
presets.desc: One saw voice an octave below the note, a plucky filter and a short glide: a synth bass line from a guitar
presets.notes: Mono: exact pitch with the octave guard; play single notes, a chord gives its lowest note

presets.name: Bass square and sub
presets.desc: A bass guitar's notes as a square wave over a sub-octave square, low-passed: a fat synth bass
presets.notes: Lowest 35 Hz opens the detector and the bank floor to a five-string's low B

presets.name: Squelchy lead
presets.desc: A resonant pulse lead whose filter jumps with the pick strength, gliding between notes and bending exactly
presets.notes: Residue 0: only the voice, a classic mono synth (the attack is silent until the note is read, 12 – 29 ms)

presets.name: Stepped robot lead
presets.desc: A thin pulse lead locked to the nearest semitone: bends and vibrato step like a sequencer
presets.notes: Chromatic holds a note with hysteresis: a vibrato across a boundary does not trill

presets.name: Bending chord pad
presets.desc: Detuned saw waves on every string that follow each string's bend: a pad that bends, chords included
presets.notes: Dual sends a bending band back to the fast bank, so the bend is followed within 16 ms

presets.name: 8-bit fuzz synth
presets.desc: Square waves per partial on the fast bank, held flat and wide open: a chiptune fuzz-synth
presets.notes: Fast bank: the tightest attack; chords turn gritty, which is the sound here

presets.name: Guitar plus synth layer
presets.desc: The guitar untouched with a saw synth under it, 6 dB down: a doubled part from one take
presets.notes: The dry is sample-aligned and untouched: the synth sits under the guitar in time

presets.name: Swelled strings
presets.desc: Saw waves that rise slowly under every note and follow the string's level: a bowed, violin-like swell
presets.notes: Attack is the minimum rise in Follow: the pick disappears, the note swells in

presets.name: Expression filter sweep
presets.desc: A resonant synth whose cut-off is swept from the expression pedal, heel dark to toe bright
presets.notes: Put the expression pedal on cutoff; the 7-bit steps are smoothed (golem contract)

register.name: Register
register.help: Tutti 88 8800 008 · Trio 88 8000 000 + 3rd percussion · Choir 66 8848 588 · Bark 88 8800 000, 147 driven · Nave 80 8808 008, slow attack, scanner · Chime 00 8000 808 (the tempered third rings) · Velvet 80 3600 000 · Combo 00 8030 200, reedy, scanner · Coupler 00 8800 000 · Custom: the expert drawbars, percussion, vibrato and speaker

organ.name: Organ
organ.help: Organ level before the Leslie's drive: on EXP it is the organ's swell pedal; −60 = off

dry.name: Dry
dry.help: Guitar level, untouched (gfx-polysynth's id and range)

mod.name: Mod
mod.help: Modulation depth relative to the register: 0 = none, 50 % = the register's, 100 % = twice (scanner V1 → V3, Leslie Doppler + AM)

click.name: Click
click.help: Key click at each pick: contact bounce + burst, scaled by the pick's strength

leslie.name: Rotor
leslie.help: Stop · Slow · Fast: the rotor's speed, the footswitch (golem organ's id); the ramp is the rotors' inertia

db16.help: Custom only. Drawbar 16' (sub-octave): 0 out, 1 – 8 in 3 dB steps, 8 = 0 dB

db513.name: 5⅓'
db513.help: Custom only. Drawbar 5⅓' (the fifth below the 8'): 0 out, 1 – 8 in 3 dB steps, 8 = 0 dB

db8.help: Custom only. Drawbar 8' (the note): 0 out, 1 – 8 in 3 dB steps, 8 = 0 dB

db4.help: Custom only. Drawbar 4' (octave): 0 out, 1 – 8 in 3 dB steps, 8 = 0 dB

db223.name: 2⅔'
db223.help: Custom only. Drawbar 2⅔' (twelfth): 0 out, 1 – 8 in 3 dB steps, 8 = 0 dB

db2.help: Custom only. Drawbar 2' (two octaves): 0 out, 1 – 8 in 3 dB steps, 8 = 0 dB

db135.name: 1⅗'
db135.help: Custom only. Drawbar 1⅗' (the tempered third, two octaves up): 0 out, 1 – 8 in 3 dB steps, 8 = 0 dB

db113.name: 1⅓'
db113.help: Custom only. Drawbar 1⅓' (nineteenth): 0 out, 1 – 8 in 3 dB steps, 8 = 0 dB

db1.help: Custom only. Drawbar 1' (three octaves; muted while percussion is on): 0 out, 1 – 8 in 3 dB steps, 8 = 0 dB

perc_trig.name: Perc Trigger
perc_trig.help: Pick: every pick restarts the percussion · Single: only after every note has stopped (the Hammond and B9 rule)

vibrato.name: Vibrato
vibrato.help: Off · V1 / V2 / V3: the scanner's vibrato, shallow to deep · C1 / C2 / C3: the same with the dry (chorus)

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.help: Off: no rotor (gfx-rotary after the pedal) · 122 · 147 · 145 · Vibratone · 122 Rear: gfx-rotary's cabinets

tuning.name: Tuning
tuning.help: Tonewheel: the gear ratios (1⅗' +14 ¢, the fifths −1.4 ¢) · Pure: exact ratios

drive.name: Drive
drive.help: Leslie tube preamp, on top of the register's (contract id)

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.help: Scales the rotors' accelerate / decelerate times (gfx-rotary)

hold.name: Hold
hold.help: 100 % = each note held at its body level until it stops (organ); 0 % = follows the string's decay

touch.name: Touch
touch.help: How much the pick's strength sets the level (a global gain: chord balance kept)

strings.name: Strings
strings.help: Partials that are not roots, as sines: 0 = pure organ, 100 % = the guitar's colour added

bank.name: Resolution
bank.help: Dual: fast bank on attacks, clean bank on held notes · Fast: the 8' tight, the registration still from the clean bank · Clean: slowest attack, cleanest

lowest.name: Lowest Note
lowest.help: Bank floor: 70 Hz guitar, 35 Hz bass (gfx-polysynth's)

trails.name: Trails
trails.help: On: bypass releases the organ over release and lets the Leslie's rotors coast

presets.name: Organ trio comping
presets.desc: Chords become an 88 8000 000 organ with 3rd percussion and a slow rotor; the guitar's top removed
presets.notes: Let chords ring and mute to stop: the registration blooms 100 - 170 ms after the pick

presets.name: Organ trio solo, fast rotor
presets.desc: Single lines as a percussive drawbar organ with the rotor on fast; medium tempo lines bloom
presets.notes: Fast picked lines are heard as their sine, percussion and click; slower lines get the full registration

presets.name: Gospel swell
presets.desc: A full gospel registration with scanner chorus and rotor; the expression pedal on Organ swells it
presets.notes: Put the expression pedal on organ: it drives the rotor's preamp harder, as a swell pedal does

presets.name: Driven rock organ
presets.desc: Chords through a driven 147 rotor with 2nd percussion: a 60s rock organ

presets.name: Garage combo organ
presets.desc: A reedy, square-ish combo organ with scanner vibrato and no rotor

presets.name: Cathedral pad
presets.desc: Held chords as a slow-attack organ pad under a shallow scanner shimmer, dry guitar kept under it
presets.notes: The slow attack hides the registration's bloom entirely

presets.name: Bell organ arpeggios
presets.desc: Arpeggios as an organ whose tempered third and 1' ring, slow 3rd percussion, scanner chorus
presets.notes: Single notes above the 7th fret speak best

presets.name: Mellow ballad organ
presets.desc: Chords at one even level as a mellow 80 3600 000 organ with a slow rotor

presets.name: Octave organ lead
presets.desc: Lead lines doubled an octave up by the organ's coupler, soft percussion, a touch of dry

presets.name: Guitar plus organ
presets.desc: The dry guitar untouched with an organ layer under it

presets.name: Bass organ
presets.desc: Bass lines as an 88 8000 000 organ, foldback keeping the 16' above 65 Hz, no rotor

presets.name: Ballad drawbars 80 0000 008
presets.desc: A near-sine 16' with the 1' on top: Hammond's pop ballad sheet, slow rotor

presets.name: Full organ 88 8888 888
presets.desc: Every drawbar out: a full, bright organ on a fast rotor

presets.name: Organ for a rotary after it
presets.desc: The Trio registration with the speaker off, for gfx-rotary's full panel after the pedal
presets.notes: Custom starts as golem's organ block (88 8000 000); add the 3rd percussion as Trio has it

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Band level (a sine's dBFS in its band) at Center where the work starts; the same reading at every window

down.name: Down
down.help: Downward ratio above the threshold curve, per band; 1 = off

up.name: Up
up.help: Upward ratio below the curve, never under the noise guard; 1 = off

slope.name: Slope
slope.help: Tilts the threshold about Center in dB per octave; 0 is flat for pink noise, negative holds the highs sooner

attack.name: Attack
attack.help: How fast a rising band is held; the window adds a quarter to a half of its length

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: Live: zero latency, two-thirds-octave bells. Studio: per bin inside the STFT, latency of the window. Set before playing

release.name: Release
release.help: How fast a falling band is let go

window.name: Window
window.help: Analysis size (samples at 48 kHz): longer resolves lower notes, reacts later; Studio's latency. Set before playing

res.name: Resolution
res.help: Width of each bin's detector band (semitones): wider is smoother, less musical noise; 0 = the main lobe

knee.name: Knee
knee.help: Quadratic knee around the threshold, both directions

guard.name: Noise Guard
guard.help: Nothing at or under this level is lifted: the upward stage never raises hiss

source.name: Source
source.help: What the detector reads: the lane itself, or the key (the lane's DI today); no key = no change

auto_gain.name: Auto Gain
auto_gain.help: Static make-up from the settings (pink noise at -18 dBFS RMS matches bypass); 0 dB under a key

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Dry / wet, the dry aligned to the wet

link.name: Stereo Link
link.help: Stereo: each channel's band levels move toward the louder one's

delta.name: Delta
delta.help: Hear only what the compressor changes (wet minus dry)

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: The dry, still delayed in Studio so the lane's latency stays

presets.name: Gentle glue
presets.desc: Two-to-one on every band over the curve, a little lift under it: a whole mix leans together
presets.notes: golem's legacy preset, converted once (README §3.4): Studio, the legacy block had no caps and no make-up

presets.name: De-harsh vocal
presets.desc: Holds the 3 kHz and up region of a bright voice as it gets harsh; the body passes
presets.notes: Legacy preset, converted once (README §3.4); Studio at 1024 (21 ms). vocal-de-harsh is its Live sibling

presets.name: Keys even
presets.desc: Evens a keyboard part across its range so no register jumps out of the mix
presets.notes: Legacy preset, converted once (README §3.4)

presets.name: Pad hold
presets.desc: Pulls a pad's loud bands down and lifts its quiet ones: a steady, even bed
presets.notes: Legacy preset, converted once (README §3.4); window 4096 in Studio (85 ms)

presets.name: Pink noise wash
presets.desc: Squashes anything toward pink noise, mixed under the dry: the legacy wash, unguarded
presets.notes: Legacy preset, converted once (README §3.4), mix and out exact. spectral-wash is the guarded new sound

presets.name: Vocal smooth
presets.desc: Evens a voice band by band, highs held a little sooner: smoother, never pumping
presets.notes: Legacy preset, converted once (README §3.4). vocal-smooth-live is its zero-latency sibling

presets.name: Vocal upfront
presets.desc: Lifts a voice's quiet detail and holds its peaks, blended in parallel: closer, denser
presets.notes: Legacy preset, converted once (README §3.4), mix and out exact

presets.name: Even clean strum
presets.desc: Strummed clean chords: the low strings stop masking the top ones, with no broadband pumping
presets.notes: README §4. Live: zero latency on a played lane

presets.name: Glassy arpeggio
presets.desc: Arpeggios whose quiet notes ring as loud as the picked ones
presets.notes: README §4. The lift stops at 9 dB and never raises what sits under the guard

presets.name: Crunch de-fizz
presets.desc: After a drive: the fizz above 3 kHz is held as the gain rises, the chug passes
presets.notes: README §4 (Review change 5): Main, not the DI key, since the DI has no fizz to read

presets.name: Bass even strings
presets.desc: Bass whose strings read at different levels: the lows held, the fingers' detail kept
presets.notes: README §4; window 2048 reads the low E cleanly (1.5-bin floor: 35 Hz)

presets.name: Bass growl lift
presets.desc: Brings up a bass's growl and finger noise without lifting the amp's hiss
presets.notes: README §4 (Review change 11: window 2048 for bass)

presets.name: Vocal smooth live
presets.desc: A live voice: ringing resonances and harsh vowels held, zero latency in the in-ears
presets.notes: README §4

presets.name: Vocal de-harsh
presets.desc: Holds the harshness and sibilant edges of a bright mic at zero latency
presets.notes: README §4; pair with gfx-deesser for the sibilants themselves

presets.name: Spectral wash
presets.desc: Squashes anything toward pink noise, guarded: an ambient bed under the dry
presets.notes: README §4: a new sound beside the converted pink-noise-wash, with the guard and the default res

presets.name: Make room for voice
presets.desc: Keyed by the singer: the instrument steps out of the voice's harmonics only
presets.notes: README §4: needs golem-rack's key_from (another lane's voice); with no key it does nothing

presets.name: Fill the gaps
presets.desc: A pad keyed by the lead: it rises where the lead leaves room
presets.notes: README §4; auto gain is 0 dB under a key, so a silent key changes nothing

presets.name: Tame ringing room
presets.desc: An acoustic or a mic that rings: the ring is held over two-thirds of an octave as it builds
presets.notes: README §4: 63 % at the output in about 11 ms. It does not replace a notch

drive.name: Drive
drive.help: Shared id: 0.48 dB per % into the dirt (0 – 48 dB), displayed "% (dB)"; every band, under its trim

morph.name: Morph
morph.help: Type A → type B in every band, and object → object_b, level-held

box.name: Box
box.help: Direct → inside the object; 0 = the bank is skipped

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: The dirt's wet per band against the aligned dry

guard.name: Guard
guard.help: Loop-gain cap threshold (dBFS RMS): under it the pedal is quieter than bypass at every frequency; -90 = off. Set at soundcheck about 10 dB over the bleed, watching the state lamp

defizz.name: De-fizz
defizz.help: Lowers the drive while an 's' passes, then shelves its band down: up to 18 dB; 0 for guitar and drums

env_drive.name: Env → Drive
env_drive.help: The voice's envelope (10 ms RMS, -48 to -12 dBFS) into the drive: + louder singing distorts more, - the dirt backs off on loud notes

env_morph.name: Env → Morph
env_morph.help: The envelope added to morph: louder singing moves toward type B and object B

tilt.name: Tilt
tilt.help: + = brighter into the dirt (more bite), − = darker (more body)

low_a.name: Low Type A
low_a.help: Low band (the chest, under the low crossover): the band's dirt type (Off, Soft, Hard, Tube, Fuzz, Rectify, Fold, Sine Fold, Crush, Decimate, Sputter, Ring, Carbon, Starve, Rasp) at morph 0 %

body_a.name: Body Type A
body_a.help: Body band (the vowel; the whole voice in Single): the band's dirt type (Off, Soft, Hard, Tube, Fuzz, Rectify, Fold, Sine Fold, Crush, Decimate, Sputter, Ring, Carbon, Starve, Rasp) at morph 0 %

air_a.name: Air Type A
air_a.help: Air band (sibilance and breath, over the air crossover): the band's dirt type (Off, Soft, Hard, Tube, Fuzz, Rectify, Fold, Sine Fold, Crush, Decimate, Sputter, Ring, Carbon, Starve, Rasp) at morph 0 %

low_b.name: Low Type B
low_b.help: Low band's type at morph 100 %: the morph blends A into B, level-held

body_b.name: Body Type B
body_b.help: Body band's type at morph 100 %: the morph blends A into B, level-held

air_b.name: Air Type B
air_b.help: Air band's type at morph 100 %: the morph blends A into B, level-held

low_trim.name: Low Drive Trim
low_trim.help: Added to the low band's drive (dB)

body_trim.name: Body Drive Trim
body_trim.help: Added to the body band's drive (dB); in Single it is a second drive control

air_trim.name: Air Drive Trim
air_trim.help: Added to the air band's drive (dB)

low_level.name: Low Level
low_level.help: The whole low band after the mix; -60 = mute

body_level.name: Body Level
body_level.help: The whole body band after the mix, into the box and the comp; -60 = mute

air_level.name: Air Level
air_level.help: The whole air band after the mix; -60 = mute

object_b.name: Object B
object_b.help: The object morph target; Same = no object morph (morph moves the dirt only)

order.name: Order
order.help: Dirt → Box: a distorted voice heard through the object; Box → Dirt: the object's peaks clip first

env_filter.name: Env → Filter
env_filter.help: The envelope moves the post high cut by up to ±4 octaves: a talking filter

echo_time.name: Echo Time
echo_time.help: The slap's delay (ms), gliding when moved

echo_fb.name: Echo Feedback
echo_fb.help: The slap's repeats, through a 4 kHz low-pass in the loop

level.name: Level
level.help: Output level (dB), after everything; presets are level-matched with it

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: nih-plug make_bypass, with the box and echo tails

presets.name: Scream edge
presets.desc: A screamed lead that stays intelligible: chest boom cut before the dirt, sibilants kept clean, level even
presets.notes: The voice default: Single band (no dispersion in the ears), Tube grit with Fuzz waiting on the morph; comp 40 % holds the take

presets.name: Scream swell
presets.desc: The louder the scream, the more it breaks up: the envelope raises the drive and morphs Soft into Fuzz
presets.notes: Sung quietly it stays nearly clean; the dynamics of the voice play the dirt

presets.name: Growl split
presets.desc: Metal growl: chest clean and solid, a rasped body, no fizz on top
presets.notes: The clean-lows split of bass rigs, for voice; Three bands turn the phase 163° at the crossover: heard as a hollow chest in in-ears

presets.name: Parallel grit
presets.desc: A distorted layer blended under the clean voice, phase-aligned, so the words stay readable
presets.notes: Mix 35 %: the dry carries the words, the wet carries the edge; the guard's cap follows the mix

presets.name: Acoustic megaphone
presets.desc: A shout through a cone: thin mid honk, clipped, with a slap off the street
presets.notes: The acoustic horn with no amplifier; the electronic megaphone is a gfx-radio device

presets.name: Shout in a can
presets.desc: Shouting into a can taped to a cheap mic: the can's resonant peaks clip first
presets.notes: Box → Dirt: the object before the clipper, so its peaks are what distorts

presets.name: String phone
presets.desc: The child's can telephone: thin, ringing, barely dirty
presets.notes: Position 30 % moves the ear toward the closed end; the low cut takes the body away

presets.name: Bucket head
presets.desc: Singing with a bucket over the head: a boxy low resonance around the voice
presets.notes: Box 70 % keeps some direct sound for the consonants

presets.name: Bottle ghost
presets.desc: A hollow, haunted whisper inside a bottle, half dry, with a long dark slap
presets.notes: The bottle's 108 Hz Helmholtz peak is its loudest point: the guard counts it, raise the threshold on a loud stage

presets.name: Oil drum boom
presets.desc: A voice from inside a steel drum: a long metallic boom under a warm grit
presets.notes: The comp after the box holds the drum's resonant peaks note to note

presets.name: Glass jar sweep
presets.desc: A glassy formant sweep: the expression pedal moves the ear inside a jar
presets.notes: Put the EXP pedal on position (0 – 100 %): the notches sweep through the jar's mode series

presets.name: Cupped hands blues
presets.desc: The cupped bullet-mic voice of a harmonica player, put on a singer: midrange bark and grit
presets.notes: Carbon is the old-mic second-harmonic grain; the hands are a small Helmholtz cavity around 500 Hz

presets.name: Robot ring
presets.desc: The robot: a ring-modulated voice that turns into a sampled edge as the morph rises
presets.notes: Decimate's half-hold delay combs against the ring when they blend: part of the sound

presets.name: Broken transmission
presets.desc: A voice that drops out and sputters on loud syllables, through a cardboard box and a narrow band
presets.notes: Louder syllables morph into the starving rail; quiet ones fall into the sputter's dead zone

presets.name: Object morph
presets.desc: One pedal sweep turns a small can into an oil drum and soft grit into folding
presets.notes: Put the EXP pedal on morph (0 – 100 %); Fold's own law stops at 24 dB, so the sweep never turns to noise

presets.name: Drum bus crush
presets.desc: Parallel crushed drums in a box, the kick's body kept clean underneath
presets.notes: Guard and de-fizz off: a drum bus has no stage bleed through this block, and cymbals read as sibilants

presets.name: Can lead guitar
presets.desc: A fuzz solo through a tin can, the low strings kept clean
presets.notes: Morph toward Sine Fold for an octave-up shimmer on the top notes

formant.name: Formant
formant.help: Moves the envelope: below 0 bigger and darker (giant), above smaller and lighter (child, chipmunk)

growl.name: Growl
growl.help: Alternate periods attenuated, plus roughness: a growl at f0 / 2

vowel.name: Vowel
vowel.help: Vowel template position a · e · i · o · u (0, 25, 50, 75, 100 %)

vowel_amt.name: Vowel Amount
vowel_amt.help: 0 = the input's own formants (moved); 100 % = replaced by the vowel (talk-box)

shift.name: Pitch
shift.help: Pitch change, Grain only: the descriptor carries depends: engine = Grain, so golem greys it in Live, and Live ignores it

source.name: Source
source.help: Voice: window and envelope detail from the sung pitch, unvoiced handling

unvoiced.name: Unvoiced Shift
unvoiced.help: Share of the formant shift applied to consonants and breath (noise-like frames; never chords)

tilt.name: Tilt
tilt.help: Source tilt around 1 kHz, clamped ±12 dB

breath.name: Breath
breath.help: Aspiration noise shaped by the new envelope

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Below it the envelope is held and Grain's gate closes (gfx-golem's id)

lookahead.name: Lookahead
lookahead.help: Live only: delays the audio to centre the analysis; reported as latency, rounded to whole samples

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Linear crossfade with the dry delayed to match

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: Shared id (no tail, so no trails)

presets.name: Bigger voice
presets.desc: The same singer a little larger and darker: formants 3 semitones down, pitch and timing untouched
presets.notes: README 4: Live, formant -2 to -4. Zero latency in the in-ears; the TE envelope keeps it from sounding metallic

presets.name: Lighter voice
presets.desc: Formants 3 semitones up on the same notes: female formants sit 15 - 20 % above male ones
presets.notes: README 4: +2.4 to +3.2 st is the male-female formant distance (Peterson & Barney); pitch stays put

presets.name: Child
presets.desc: A small throat on the sung melody: formants 6 semitones up, consonants moved half as much
presets.notes: README 4: Live +6 to +10 with unvoiced 50 % so sibilants do not thin out

presets.name: Chipmunk, same notes
presets.desc: The cartoon-chipmunk timbre without the pitch jump: formants 10 semitones up on the sung notes
presets.notes: Beyond +7 the +24 dB boost clamp already limits how far the valleys rise; unvoiced 50 % keeps the s and t

presets.name: Giant
presets.desc: Pitch 5 semitones and formants 7 semitones down, with some growl and a darker source
presets.notes: README 4: pitch and formant together; the growl is epoch-synchronous in Grain

presets.name: Demon
presets.desc: An octave down, formants 5 semitones down, heavy growl and breath: the horror-film voice
presets.notes: README 4: every throat option at once; mix 100 % so the dry octave above never shows

presets.name: Gender up
presets.desc: Pitch a fifth up and formants 3 semitones up: a lower voice turned higher, both cues moved
presets.notes: README 4: formant alone gives a small man; a real change needs pitch too. Register Low tracks male voices

presets.name: Gender down
presets.desc: Pitch a fifth down and formants 3 semitones down: a higher voice turned lower, both cues moved
presets.notes: README 4: the reverse of gender-up. Grain is the engine that moves the pitch

presets.name: Sung growl
presets.desc: Alternate glottal periods dropped on the predicted epochs: a rough growl on a sung line, zero latency
presets.notes: README 4: growl 30 - 50 %; the modulation runs at f0 / 2, heard as roughness, not tremolo

presets.name: Whisper ghost
presets.desc: Aspiration noise shaped by the shifted envelope on top of a darker voice
presets.notes: README 4: the breath follows the voice's level and the voicing gate; tilt -3 dB/oct for a slacker source

presets.name: Fast lines, live
presets.desc: A slightly bigger voice whose filter keeps up with fast articulation: 20 ms lookahead
presets.notes: README 4: lookahead 20 ms centres the analysis (glide error about 2 dB rms instead of 7) at 20 ms of latency

presets.name: Another singer
presets.desc: A parallel double with formants 2 semitones up: same notes, another throat
presets.notes: README 4: Grain's identity is exact, so only the formants differ; best on a parallel lane

presets.name: Small box
presets.desc: Guitar body made smaller: the envelope 4 semitones up, notes and attack untouched
presets.notes: README 4: a tone effect that leaves pitch and attack alone, polyphonic, zero latency

presets.name: Big box
presets.desc: Guitar body made bigger: the envelope 4 semitones down, a wider, darker box
presets.notes: README 4: Instrument's fixed window and 150 ms envelope smoothing keep chords free of new partials

presets.name: Talk-box sweep
presets.desc: Vowels imposed on the chord: a talk-box without the tube, the vowel on the expression pedal
presets.notes: README 4: put vowel on EXP and sweep a to u; vowel_amt 85 % keeps a little of the guitar's own body

presets.name: Bass giant
presets.desc: Bass body 5 semitones down: a bigger cabinet in the low mids, the noise floor guarded
presets.notes: README 4: the noise-floor guard keeps the shift from lifting hiss

presets.name: Vowel pad
presets.desc: A pad sung on the vowel i: the synth's own envelope replaced by the template
presets.notes: README 4: vowel 50 % is i; vowel_amt 100 % replaces the input's envelope entirely
